data.name: 駒山キリは全部やりにいく
data.detailed_description:
The hugely popular streamer Komayama Kiri finally stars in her own streaming survival action game!

Join the fox-eared, glasses-wearing V-streamer Komayama Kiri as she livestreams her way through mysterious, galaxy-scale trials!

Falling, streaming, drama, viral fame, and endless waves of enemies――.

Grow as a streamer while surviving overwhelming threats from every direction.

What is the true nature of the mysterious entity known as 【NEKO】?
What is really happening behind the Perseus Constellation Annual Video Awards?

Can Komayama Kiri really “do absolutely everything” until the very end!?

Game Features:

"Komayama Kiri Does Everything" is a collection of games themed around streaming.

▶ A falling action game where you dodge obstacles on your descent
・Use invincibility frames from emergency evasive maneuvers to make it safely to the ground.

▶ A simulation game where you edit your streams into videos, spread them across the universe, and build your popularity
・Upgrade your streaming equipment and editing setup to take on even greater challenges.

▶ A survivor-like action game where you dodge enemy hordes, fight back, grow stronger, and survive for a set time
・Combine a wide variety of upgrades to create your own unique build.

Streaming culture, cosmic entities, and chaotic events create one bizarre situation after another.

Each mini-game features its own unique gameplay and events.

Enjoy the game even if you're completely new to Komayama Kiri.

Play Time

80–120 minutes

Video & Streaming Guidelines

You may freely livestream, upload videos, and create content featuring this game without needing permission from the publisher.

Monetization of gameplay videos and streams is fully allowed on any platform, including donations, memberships, and all other monetization systems.

We would appreciate it if you include the game title in your stream/video title and link the Steam page in the description whenever possible.

The publisher assumes no responsibility for any damages or issues resulting from streaming or uploading videos of this game.

If there are any discrepancies in interpretation, the Japanese version of these guidelines shall take precedence.

These guidelines may be changed without prior notice.
